name: Postiz
desc: Open-source social media scheduling tool supporting 30+ platforms

actions.name: create_post
actions.description: Create or schedule a post on one or more connected channels

actions.name: list_posts
actions.description: Retrieve posts within a date range

actions.name: delete_post
actions.description: Delete a post and all other posts in the same group

actions.name: list_integrations
actions.description: List all connected social media channels in your organization

actions.name: find_available_slot
actions.description: Find the next available posting time slot for a connected channel

actions.name: get_platform_analytics
actions.description: Retrieve analytics (followers, impressions, engagement) for a connected channel

actions.name: get_post_analytics
actions.description: Retrieve analytics (likes, comments, shares, impressions) for a specific published post

actions.name: upload_file_from_url
actions.description: Upload a media file from a URL to Postiz. Returns the file path to use when creating posts.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_post
triggers.description: Triggers when a post is published in Postiz
